fact: The Gambia's IFMIS overview in the 2021 IFMIS Capacity Building Program slides states that 8 local government entities are connected to the system, alongside 85 central government entities, and lists rollout to local councils as a result achieved.
title: The Gambia IFMIS Implementation Experience
publisher: World Bank, 2021 IFMIS Capacity Building Program (Gambia Accountant General's Department presentation)
